items.d: Managed WordPress or VPS hosting with server-level caching and PHP 8+ — not a ₹99/month shared plan.
A caching plugin or host-level page cache serves prebuilt pages instead of rebuilding every request.
WebP format, sized to display dimensions, lazy-loaded below the fold — not full-size camera uploads.
Every active plugin earns its place; unused ones deleted (not just deactivated); no overlapping duplicates.
Static files delivered from edge locations near your visitors — critical for India’s mobile networks.

items.t: Core Web Vitals pass on mobile
items.d: Green LCP/CLS/INP in PageSpeed Insights on mobile, not just desktop.
Unique titles and meta descriptions, an XML sitemap submitted to Google Search Console, clean permalinks.
Structured data for your business/products so Google (and AI search) understands the site.
Valid SSL, all assets over HTTPS, HTTP redirecting to HTTPS.
Any rebuild/migration preserved URLs or 301-redirected old ones — no ranking thrown away.

verdicts.title: Solid:
verdicts.text: Your site\u2019s foundations look good. Keep plugins updated, re-run this quarterly, and consider a professional Core Web Vitals pass to squeeze out the rest.

verdicts.title: Gaps to close:
verdicts.text: Real gaps, but fixable ones. Start with hosting and caching \u2014 they\u2019re the biggest wins \u2014 then images, then the plugin audit. Most of this is days of work, not a rebuild.

verdicts.title: Losing customers:
verdicts.text: At this score your site is actively costing you speed, rankings and conversions. The fixes are well-understood \u2014 hosting, caching, images, redirects \u2014 and a focused rescue usually beats starting over.
